title: 7 Signs the Men Around You Actually Know Your Sin
caption:
Not the guys who know your name. The ones who know your actual sin.

He's the one who texts first when you go quiet, not the one who waits for the update. He can name the specific thing you're fighting, not the vague version you post. He's canceled a plan to sit with you on a bad night.

A gym partner reschedules. A brother shows up.

"Faithful are the wounds of a friend, but deceitful are the kisses of an enemy." (Proverbs 27:6)

Online friends get your highlight reel. A gym crew gets your reps. A group chat gets whatever you're willing to type. Count how many men actually get the real one.

#faith #brotherhood #christianmen #manofgod #community
